title: Watch the Weeki Wachee mermaids perform
description: Take a seat in Weeki Wachee Springs’ underwater theater and watch performers move through the clear spring beyond the glass. The mermaids tell stories, perform underwater feats, and carry on a Florida attraction with decades of history. Remember that the water is real and the swimmers are working in it; their skill is as striking as the fantasy.
teaser: See live mermaids through an underwater theater window.
goodToKnow: Audience seated in an auditorium; no swimming. Confirm show times and seating access.
whyItMightDelightYou: The show keeps a delightfully unusual piece of Florida roadside history alive.
